issue.title: Short option handling doesn’t consume value token for combined short flags (e.g. -som foo)
issue.body:
## My urfave/cli version is

_**( v3.6.2 )**_

## Checklist

- [x] Are you running the latest v3 release? The list of releases is [here](https://github.com/urfave/cli/releases).

## Dependency Management

<!--
  Delete any of the following that do not apply:
-->

- My project is using go modules.

## Describe the bug

Short option handling doesn’t consume value token for combined short flags but they are consumed if short flags appear individually. (e.g. foo in `-som foo baa` will be parsed twice)
